line: Someone agrees with everything you say today. Suspicious, but enjoy it.
Someone wants what you want. Share the credit, not the last piece of chicken.
Your shower thought is the good one. Write it down before you dry off.
Ask for help today. Yes, you. Nothing bad will happen.
Today pushes back. Do the hardest thing first and the rest gets easy.
Someone notices your effort today. Act surprised.
Say yes to the random invite. Read the fine print first.
Not a shopping day. A checking-your-bank-app day.
Cook something, share something. Calories don't count today. (They do.)
You're right today. Say it kindly and it actually lands.
